query: What steps are necessary to report a case of forced marriage or child marriage to the police?
reference_answer:
Reporting Forced/Child Marriage:
To report a forced or child marriage, call the Tamil Nadu Police helpline: 1091 or 181. You can also contact the Childline (1098) or visit the nearest police station. Provide details about the incident, and the police will take necessary action.
answer: To report a case of forced marriage or child marriage to the police, contact local law enforcement immediately. Provide details about the situation, including dates, locations, and any witnesses. Ensure the victim's safety and well-being are prioritized. [Document 1]
